name: musubicad
description: Parametric CAD your agent can iterate on without breaking it: a Design Graph with named, unit-bearing parameters is the source of truth, and every change is dry-run, regenerated with OpenCASCADE, and checked against its declared intent before it is written. Exports STEP for CAD/CAM and STL for 3D printing.
